grammar.title: Greeting someone by name
grammar.ar: نقول Hello أو Hi عندما نقابل شخصًا في بداية الدرس، وكلمة Hi أبسط وأكثر ودًّا. نضع اسم الشخص بعد التحية، مثل: Hello, Sara! وفي نهاية الدرس نقول Goodbye أو See you next time عند المغادرة.
examples: Goodbye, Miss Lina! See you next time!

dialogue.t: Nice to meet you, too. What's your name?

grammar.title: What's your name? / My name is ...
grammar.ar: نسأل عن الاسم بقول What's your name? وكلمة What's هي اختصار What is. نجيب بقول My name is ... أو I'm ... وكلمة I'm هي اختصار I am وتعني «أنا». لا نقول I'm is، بل I'm Sara فقط.
examples: I'm Lina. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.t: Hi, Yusuf! How old are you?
Let's count! One, two, three, four, five.

grammar.title: Saying your age: I'm + number
grammar.ar: للسؤال عن العمر نقول How old are you? ونجيب بقول I'm ثم الرقم، مثل I'm seven. يمكننا أيضًا أن نضيف years old في النهاية، مثل I'm seven years old. لا نقول I have seven years كما في العربية، ولا نحذف I'm.
examples: I'm eight years old. And you?

dialogue.t: Good morning, Adam! How are you?

grammar.title: Talking about feelings: I'm + feeling
grammar.ar: نسأل عن الحال بقول How are you? ونجيب بقول I'm ثم الشعور، مثل I'm happy. في العربية نقول «أنا سعيد» بدون فعل، لكن في الإنجليزية يجب أن نقول I'm وليس I happy. بعد الإجابة نقول thank you ثم نسأل And you?
examples: I'm fine, thank you. And you?

words.ex: Can I have a book, please?
Can I have a pencil, please?

dialogue.t: Can I have a pencil, please?

grammar.title: Asking politely with please
grammar.ar: عندما نطلب شيئًا بأدب نقول Can I have ... please? أو نذكر اسم الشيء ثم please، مثل A pencil, please. نضع a قبل اسم الشيء الواحد. عندما نأخذ الشيء نقول Thank you، ويرد الشخص الآخر بقول You're welcome.
examples: Can I have a pencil, please?

dialogue.t: Hello, Miss Lina! This is my friend.
She's Mona. She's seven years old.
And this is Teddy. He's my puppet.
Hi, Teddy! How old is he?

grammar.title: Introducing people: This is ... / He's ... / She's ...
grammar.ar: نقدّم شخصًا بقول This is ... مثل This is my friend. نستخدم He للولد أو الرجل، ونستخدم She للبنت أو المرأة، مثل «هو» و«هي» في العربية. He's اختصار He is، وShe's اختصار She is، ولا نحذف 's.

words.ex: The book is on the desk.

grammar.title: This and That / a and an
grammar.ar: نستخدم this (هذا) للشيء القريب منّا، وthat (ذلك) للشيء البعيد عنّا. نقول a قبل الكلمة التي تبدأ بصوت ساكن مثل a pen، ونقول an قبل الكلمة التي تبدأ بصوت متحرك (a, e, i, o, u) مثل an eraser. وفي الإنجليزية لا بدّ من كتابة It's في الجواب، فلا نقول "a pen" وحدها كجملة كاملة.

words.ex: Do you have a pencil case?

dialogue.t: Look! I have a pencil case.
I have a pencil case, too.
Yes, I do. Do you have a crayon?
No, I don't. I don't have a crayon.
Do you have a glue stick?

grammar.title: I have / I don't have / Do you have?
grammar.ar: نقول I have للتعبير عن أن الشيء معنا (عندي). وللنفي نضع don't قبل have فنقول I don't have (ليس عندي). وللسؤال نبدأ بـ Do فنقول Do you have...? ونجيب بـ Yes, I do أو No, I don't.
examples: Do you have a crayon? Yes, I do.

dialogue.t: My bag is blue. I like blue.
It's green. Green is my favourite colour.

grammar.title: What colour is it? It's ...
grammar.ar: نسأل عن اللون بقولنا What colour is it? ونجيب It's red. ونقول My pen is blue لوصف لون شيء نملكه. لاحظ أننا نكتب is بين الشيء واللون، بخلاف العربية التي نقول فيها "قلمي أزرق" بدون فعل. ونستخدم I like لنقول اللون الذي نحبه.
examples: What colour is it? It's yellow.

dialogue.t: Let's count. One, two, three, four. There are four chairs.
How many pencils do you have?

grammar.title: There's one ... / There are ...
grammar.ar: نستخدم There's (يوجد) مع شيء واحد، مثل There's one book. ونستخدم There are (يوجد) مع أكثر من شيء، ونضيف s في آخر الاسم، مثل There are three books. ونسأل عن العدد بقولنا How many ... are there?
examples: How many books are there? There are seven books.

dialogue.t: Now sit down. Open your book.
Can I have a pencil, please?
Thank you. Can I close the door, please?
Yes, you can. Close the door, please.

grammar.title: Instructions and Can I ..., please?
grammar.ar: لإعطاء أمر نبدأ الجملة بالفعل مباشرة، مثل Stand up أو Open your book. ونضيف please لنكون مهذبين. ولطلب الإذن نقول Can I ..., please? مثل Can I go out, please? ويكون الجواب Yes, you can أو No, you can't.
examples: Can I close the window, please?

words.ex: My crayon is in the box.
Here you are. It's your pencil.

dialogue.t: Oh, yes! And where's my eraser?
It's on the desk. Here you are.

grammar.title: Where's ...? It's in / on / under ...
grammar.ar: نسأل عن مكان شيء بقولنا Where's my ...? (أين ...؟). ونجيب بـ It's ثم كلمة المكان: in تعني داخل، on تعني على، under تعني تحت. ونضع the قبل اسم المكان، مثل It's under the desk.
examples: Where's my ruler? It's in the box.
Where's my book? It's on the chair.
Where's my pen? It's under the desk.

dialogue.t: This is my sister. And that's my baby brother.

grammar.title: Who's this? / This is ... / That's ...
grammar.ar: نستخدم "This is" للإشارة إلى شخص أو شيء قريب منّا، ومعناها "هذا" أو "هذه". ونستخدم "That's" (اختصار That is) لشخص أو شيء بعيد عنّا، ومعناها "ذلك" أو "تلك". للسؤال عن شخص نقول "Who's this?" أي "من هذا؟". لاحظ أن this وthat تُستخدمان للمذكر والمؤنث معًا.
examples: Who's this? This is my brother.

dialogue.t: Yes, I do. I have two sisters.
No, I don't. Do you have a brother?
Yes, I do. I have three brothers!
I have a big family too!

grammar.title: I have ... / Do you have ...?
grammar.ar: نستخدم "I have" لنقول "عندي" أو "لديّ". مع شخص واحد نقول a مثل: I have a sister، ومع أكثر من واحد نضيف s في آخر الكلمة مثل: two sisters. للسؤال نقول "Do you have ...?" أي "هل عندك ...؟"، ونجيب بـ "Yes, I do" (نعم) أو "No, I don't" (لا).
examples: Do you have a cousin? Yes, I do.

dialogue.t: This is my grandma. She's kind.
That's my grandpa. He's tall and funny.

grammar.title: He's / She's + adjective
grammar.ar: نستخدم "He" للمذكر (هو) و"She" للمؤنث (هي). "He's" اختصار He is، و"She's" اختصار She is. نضع الصفة بعدها مثل: She's kind. لاحظ أن الصفة في الإنجليزية لا تتغير بين المذكر والمؤنث، ولا بد من كلمة is قبل الصفة.

words.ex: Grandpa is in the living room.

dialogue.t: Thank you! Let's go to the garden!

grammar.title: Where's ...? / He's / She's / They're in the ...
grammar.ar: نسأل عن مكان شخص بـ "Where's ...?" أي "أين ...؟". نجيب بـ "He's in the ..." للمذكر، و"She's in the ..." للمؤنث، و"They're in the ..." لأكثر من شخص (هم). كلمة in تعني "في"، ونضع the قبل اسم الغرفة.
examples: Where's Dad? He's in the kitchen.

words.ex: Yes, it is. It's my toy.

dialogue.t: No, it isn't. It's my sister's bag.
No, it isn't. It's my brother's hat.

grammar.title: Is this your ...? / It's my brother's ...
grammar.ar: نسأل عن صاحب الشيء بـ "Is this your ...?" أي "هل هذا لك؟"، ونجيب بـ "Yes, it is" (نعم) أو "No, it isn't" (لا). لنقول إن الشيء يخص شخصًا ما نضيف 's بعد اسمه مثل: my brother's bag أي "حقيبة أخي". لاحظ أن صاحب الشيء يأتي أولًا ثم الشيء، عكس العربية.
examples: Is this your book? Yes, it is.

dialogue.t: Thank you for the sweets! This present is for you.

grammar.title: Thank you for the ... / Let's ... together!
grammar.ar: نقول "Thank you for the ..." لنشكر شخصًا على شيء، أي "شكرًا على ...". ونستخدم "Let's" مع فعل لنقترح فعل شيء معًا، أي "هيّا نـ..."، مثل: Let's eat أي "هيّا نأكل". نضيف together في آخر الجملة لتعني "معًا".

dialogue.t: Yes, I do. I like eggs.
No, I don't. I don't like milk.

grammar.title: I like / Do you like?
grammar.ar: نقول I like ... لنقول «أنا أحب ...»، ونقول I don't like ... لنقول «أنا لا أحب ...». لنسأل صديقنا نضع Do في بداية السؤال: Do you like ...? نجيب بـ Yes, I do أو No, I don't، ولا نقول Yes, I like وحدها.
examples: Do you like rice? Yes, I do.

dialogue.t: I can see a lion too!

grammar.title: What's that? It's a ...
grammar.ar: نسأل What's that? يعني «ما ذلك؟» عندما نشير إلى شيء. نجيب بـ It's a ... يعني «إنه ...». في الإنجليزية لا نحذف It's، فنقول It's big وليس Big فقط. ونضع a قبل اسم الحيوان الواحد.

dialogue.t: No, I can't! Can you swim?
Yes, I can. I can swim.
Yes, I can! I can run and jump.

grammar.title: can / can't
grammar.ar: نستخدم can لنقول «يستطيع»، و can't لنقول «لا يستطيع». بعد can نضع الفعل مباشرة بدون أي تغيير، فنقول A bird can fly وليس can flies. للسؤال نضع Can في البداية: Can you swim? ونجيب Yes, I can أو No, I can't.
examples: Can you run? Yes, I can.

words.ex: My favourite toy is my doll.

dialogue.t: I have a doll and a car.
My favourite toy is my teddy bear.

grammar.title: My favourite toy is ...
grammar.ar: كلمة my تعني «ـي» مثل «لعبتي»، وكلمة your تعني «ـكَ / ـكِ» مثل «لعبتك». في الإنجليزية نضع favourite قبل الاسم، عكس العربية: «لعبتي المفضلة» = my favourite toy. نسأل What's your favourite ...? ونجيب It's ... .
examples: My favourite toy is my ball.
What's your favourite toy? It's my car.

grammar.title: Let's play ...!
grammar.ar: نستخدم Let's لندعو صديقًا، وتعني «هيا بنا». بعدها نضع الفعل play ثم اسم اللعبة: Let's play ball! نقول My turn عندما يكون الدور لنا، و Your turn عندما يكون الدور لصديقنا. ونقول Well done! لنشجع صديقنا.

words.ex: It's my car. I like it.

dialogue.t: Yes, I do. I like it.

grammar.title: This is my ... / It's red.
grammar.ar: نقول This is my ... لنعرض شيئًا لنا، وتعني «هذا ... لي». بعد It's نضع اللون أو الحجم: It's red / It's big. وعندما نضع الصفة مع الاسم تأتي قبله، عكس العربية: «سيارة حمراء» = a red car. اللون لا يتغير أبدًا في الإنجليزية.

units.cando: Can greet people, say their name, age and feelings, and ask others the same questions using simple memorised phrases.
lessons: Hello and Goodbye
Greet the teacher at the start of class and say goodbye at the end
Hello, ...! / Hi, ...! / Goodbye, ...! / See you next time!
What's Your Name?
Introduce yourself to a new classmate and ask for their name
What's your name? / My name is ... . / I'm ... . / Nice to meet you.
How Old Are You?
Tell a new friend your age and ask about theirs, counting 1-10
How old are you? / I'm ... . / I'm ... years old. / And you?
How Are You Today?
Share how you feel at the start of class and ask the teacher
How are you? / I'm happy / tired / hungry. / I'm fine, thank you. / And you?
Please and Thank You
Ask politely for things in class and respond politely
..., please. / Can I have ..., please? / Thank you. / You're welcome.
This Is My Friend
Introduce a friend or a puppet character to the teacher
This is ... . / He's ... . / She's ... . / He's / She's ... years old.

units.cando: Can name family members, say simple things about them and their home, and answer basic yes/no questions about a family photo.
lessons: Who's This?
Show a family photo and say who each person is
Who's this? / This is my mum / dad / brother / sister. / That's my ... .
My Big Family
Talk about how many brothers, sisters and cousins you have
I have ... brothers. / I have a ... . / Do you have a sister? / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
My Kind Grandma
Describe family members with simple adjectives
My ... is tall / short / kind / funny. / He's ... . / She's ... .
Where's Dad?
Find family members in different rooms of the house
Where's ...? / He's in the kitchen. / She's in the bedroom. / They're in the garden.
Is This Your Bag?
Find out who owns items left around the house
Is this your ...? / Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. / It's my brother's ... .
Eid Visit
Greet relatives and thank them during an Eid family visit
Eid Mubarak! / Thank you for the ... . / Come in, please. / Let's ... together!

units.cando: Can name classroom objects, colours and numbers, follow simple classroom instructions, and ask where things are.
lessons: What's This?
Identify objects on the teacher's desk and in the classroom
What's this? / It's a pen. / It's an eraser. / What's that? / It's a ... .
My School Bag
Check your school bag and compare it with a friend's
I have a ... . / I don't have a ... . / Do you have a ...? / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
What Colour Is It?
Describe the colours of school things and choose a favourite colour
What colour is it? / It's ... . / My ... is ... . / I like ... .
How Many?
Count classroom objects from 1 to 10 and answer questions
How many ... are there? / There are ... . / There's one ... . / I have ... .
Stand Up, Please!
Follow and give simple classroom instructions in a game
Stand up. / Sit down. / Open your book. / Close the door, please. / Can I ..., please?
Where's My Pencil?
Help a friend find lost school things
Where's my ...? / It's in / on / under the ... . / Here you are. / Thank you!

units.cando: Can say what they like and can do, ask a friend simple questions about likes and abilities, and present a favourite thing in a few short sentences.
lessons: Yummy Food
Talk about food you like at breakfast and at a family meal
I like ... . / I don't like ... . / Do you like ...? / Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
At the Zoo
Point to and describe animals on a virtual zoo visit
What's that? / It's a ... . / It's big / small. / I can see a ... .
I Can Swim!
Talk about what animals and people can and can't do
A ... can run / swim / fly. / Can you ...? / Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
My Favourite Toy
Talk about your toys and ask about a friend's favourite
I have a ... . / My favourite toy is ... . / What's your favourite ...? / It's ... .
Let's Play!
Invite a friend to play a game and take turns politely
Let's play ...! / OK! / My turn. / Your turn. / Well done!
Show and Tell
Present a favourite thing to the teacher in 3-4 sentences
This is my ... . / It's ... (colour / size). / I like it. / It's my favourite ... .
